newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Premier sees late Tuesday statement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Premier sees late Tuesday statement.

text.p: Premier Investments Ltd said it expected to make an announcement following a board meeting later on Tuesday after earlier requesting a share trading halt.

Brokers and analysts told Reuters they could only speculate what the announcement might be, and pointed to an article in the Sydney Morning Herald's CBD gossip column on Tuesday which said Premier might take itself private.
Premier is controlled by Coles Myer Ltd deputy chairman Solomon Lew and counts FAI Insurances Ltd and Guinness Peat Group Plc among its shareholders.
Lew has a 40.5 percent stake in Premier while FAI has 12 percent and GPG has about 19.8 percent.
FAI chief executive Rodney Adler was not available to comment on Tuesday morning.
Premier last Friday sold its 15 percent stake in FAI for A$33.1 million, with the shares sold to institutions by brokerage firm Prudential Bache Securities.
Premier said its directors would "consider appropriate uses" for the funds, while Lew said two months ago that he planned to increase his 14 percent stake in Coles.
